title: Viva Insights: agent query for custom agent adoption reporting in the analyst workbench
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, query behaviour, tenant prerequisites and Advanced analysis controls are supported. Minor corrections should cite the role-assignment documentation, qualify destination costs and remove checklist instructions for controls missing from the table.

claims.claim: Agent query is a custom query template in the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: In the Viva Insights web app, on the left, select Create analysis. Select Custom query, then select Agent query.

claims.claim: A price or meter specific to the agent query has not been published.

claims.claim: The agent query page names no separate charge, meter or credit rate for running the query.
claims.quote: Searched: "agent query" pricing meter cost license Viva Insights Agent 365. Read the entire Create a custom agent query page, including prerequisites and output files; it names licence prerequisites but no separate charge, meter or credit rate.

claims.claim: The agent query page does not describe retention or access controls for export destinations.
claims.quote: Searched: "agent query" PersonID identifiers retention access controls. Read agent-query in full: it names .csv, Power BI and Azure Data Lake output channels but specifies no destination retention or access-control settings.

claims.claim: The agent query page does not name a dedicated feature access policy.
claims.quote: Searched: "agent query" access disable policy PowerShell Microsoft Graph. Read agent-query, feature-access-management and manage-access-policies; agent-query names no dedicated policy.

claims.claim: An analyst runs the query explicitly to read usage data.
claims.quote:
Select Run in the screen's upper right to run the query.

After your query runs, access its results on the Analysis results page

claims.claim: Turning on Auto refresh makes the query run automatically as complete data becomes available for its grouping.
claims.quote: When turned on, your query runs automatically and refreshes whenever a new, complete set of data becomes available, based on the aggregation type (Group by) you selected.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard export FAQ says its agent IDs often do not match those in the Microsoft 365 admin center export.
claims.quote: Agent IDs in the Microsoft 365 admin center export and Agent Dashboard export won't often match because the two exports use different identifier systems.

claims.claim: The tenant policy can be created in Microsoft 365 admin center through Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app and feature > Access setting > Off > Apply access settings to > Everyone.
claims.quote: select Viva from the settings menu. Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. Select Create a policy. Name the policy and select the app and feature ... Select the Access setting option ... Off ... Select Everyone ... under Apply access settings to.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AdvancedInsights -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables advanced analysis for the tenant.
claims.quote:
you can manage access for your tenant using the Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy cmdlet:

FeatureId : AdvancedInsights

Everyone

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The Advanced analysis policy controls tenant-level access to all advanced analysis features, including custom queries.
claims.quote: To enable or disable access to all advanced analysis features at the tenant level, you can use PowerShell cmdlets or create a policy in the Microsoft 365 admin center

claims.claim: A tenant switch for the agent query alone is not documented in the admin UI or automation.
claims.quote: Searched: "agent query" access disable policy PowerShell Microsoft Graph; "agent query" "default" Viva Insights. Read agent-query, feature-access-management, manage-access-policies and control-analysis-powershell; found the broader AdvancedInsights policy, no query-only switch.

claims.claim: The feature access management table has no agent query entry.
claims.quote: Searched: "agent query" access disable policy PowerShell Microsoft Graph. Read the full Viva features management table at feature-access-management; it lists Agent Dashboard, Agent Metrics Export and Advanced insights, but not Agent query.

claims.claim: The Advanced analysis policy supports only tenant-level policies, not user or group policies.
claims.quote: This control supports tenant-level policies only, not user or group-level policies.

claims.claim: The feature access management table lists Global admin as the role that manages Advanced insights access.
claims.quote: Viva Insights web app - Advanced insights | No | Global admin | Viva Insights

claims.claim: Access policy changes take effect within 24 hours unless a feature specifies otherwise.
claims.quote: Changes to access policies take effect for the user within 24 hours, unless noted for a specific feature.

claims.claim: Agent Metrics Export governs the Agent Dashboard export surface.
claims.quote: There are two ways the global and AI admins can control the Agent 365 export experience ... The "AgentMetricsExport" VFAM control also governs Agent 365 export.

claims.claim: The agent query page does not say whether person identifiers are protected or identifiable or controlled by a setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "agent query" PersonID identifiers retention access controls. Read agent-query in full: PersonID is described as a unique identifier, without an identifiability setting. Read privacy and export-agent-data for broader and separate-surface protections.

claims.claim: Handling exported results can incur destination-specific storage or licensing costs.
claims.quote: Power BI Desktop is free to download and use for creating reports ... Power BI Pro and Premium Per User (PPU) are paid licenses that let you share content and access all features
claims.fix: Replace the destination-cost clause with 'Export destinations may incur their own storage or licensing costs.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-bi/personas/business-user/end-user-faq#is-power-bi-free; do not imply every Power BI connection requires a paid licence.
